# Kawaii Group (Japan-Bangladesh Joint Venture)

> Kawaii Group Bangladesh is a premier Japan-Bangladesh joint venture conglomerate founded in 1987. With over 35+ years of excellence, the group bridges cultures, fosters international partnerships, and empowers businesses and careers across Bangladesh, Japan, Canada, Germany, and Malaysia.

## Core Pillars & Targeted Business Services
- **FDI Consulting & Market Entry**: Supporting Japanese enterprises investing in Bangladesh and Bangladeshi firms expanding to Japan through feasibility studies, BIDA registration, special economic zones (BSEZ Japanese Economic Zone), and joint venture setup.
- **Human Resources & Global Recruitment**: Connecting skilled Bangladeshi engineers, IT developers, and certified technicians with leading Japanese corporations under Specified Skilled Worker (SSW), TITP, and professional engineering categories.
- **Japanese Language & International Education**: Intensive JLPT (N5 to N1) training, NAT-TEST preparation, Japanese corporate business etiquette (Keigo & Horenso), and study abroad counseling for universities in Japan.
- **Technology Solutions & Construction DX**: Dedicated Offshore Development Centers (ODC) in Dhaka, full-stack software development, cloud computing, and BIM (Building Information Modeling) engineering outsourcing adhering to Japanese AEC standards.
- **Manufacturing & International Trade**: High-precision apparel manufacturing (OEM & ODM), sustainable textile sourcing, strict Japanese Kenpin (inspection) compliance, and global trade logistics.
- **Travel & Tourism Services**: Corporate business travel management, official Japan visa assistance, executive delegation itineraries, and bilateral hospitality coordination.
- **Japan–Bangladesh Business Partnerships**: Cross-border joint ventures, B2B matchmaking, strategic technology alliances, and MoU execution in liaison with JETRO, JBCCI, and embassies.

## Subsidiaries & Sister Concerns
- **Kawaii Japan Career & HR Solutions**: Japan-focused talent recruitment, training, and career transition programs.
- **Kawaii Global Ventures**: Investment, business development, and international market expansion.
- **Kawaii Fashion & Trade**: High-standard garment manufacturing, export, and international supply chain solutions.
- **Kawaii Language & Skill Academy**: Premier Japanese language learning institute in Dhaka.
